source.credit: Mottola et al. (2020), The Planetary Science Journal 1, 73; Levison et al. (2025), Space Science Reviews 221, 70

constraints.axisConvention: Full axes are halved exactly. +Z is the adopted pole; +X is the arbitrary display meridian.
constraints.qualification: Ellipsoid approximation using the published convex model's maximum dimensions, as summarized by the Lucy mission paper. It does not reproduce the original irregular convex mesh or occultation silhouettes.
constraints.scale: The reference radius is the geometric mean of the approximation semiaxes. It is a rendering scale, not an independent measured mean radius or convex-model volume.

assumptions: Ellipsoid approximation using the published convex model's maximum dimensions, as summarized by the Lucy mission paper. It does not reproduce the original irregular convex mesh or occultation silhouettes.
Published prograde pole, with an arbitrary display meridian. The approximation has no qualified current surface longitude.
approximation.qualification: Observation-constrained ellipsoid; no invented local terrain or albedo.

spin.meaning: Published prograde pole, with an arbitrary display meridian. The approximation has no qualified current surface longitude.

unresolved: The original Mottola 2020 convex mesh was not located in the checked paper's supporting release.
DAMIT models 6692 and 6693 have different poles and no matched absolute scale; their geometry is not mixed with this solution.
